newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus Feb inflation dives to six pct.
newsitem.headline: Belarus Feb inflation dives to six pct.

text.p: Belarus February inflation fell to six percent against 13.3 percent in January, the president's press secretary said on Tuesday.
"Inflation was halved due to the fact that the government regulated food prices. It was a measure fully in compliance with a market economy," Valery Tolkachov told reporters.
According to an economic plan decreed by President Alexander Lukashenko, Belarus inflation is not to exceed two per cent per month in 1997.
